feasibility.source: Exact same installed Node; busy Date.now loop vs Atomics.wait; each fs-persisted PID/version before control. Original stdout/stderr pipes held by original readers.
feasibility.mechanism: PSS VA clone+threads/contexts+handles/names; DbgHelp snapshots only with verified IsProcessSnapshot callback. WCT out-of-proc flag1. Query/VM_READ/DUP_HANDLE/CREATE_PROCESS on exact owned birth. No live-process dump fallback or new privilege enabling.
feasibility.native_stack: Raw native contexts and stack bytes, not symbolized or JS stacks; no heap or token information requested.
feasibility.admission: Both controls once must have live-ready identity; complete owned census; nonzero native stack+context per thread; both parent-pipe names matched to child dump names; at least one available WCT chain. Each full worker including startup <=2s, <=16MiB, no worker error/timeout, owned cleanup complete. Per-node noaccess/unknown retained even on admitted capture. Otherwise no ordinary cohort and report capacity gap; never retry identical control. PSS snapshot callback must be seen; PssFreeSnapshot must succeed; no live-dump fallback. Snapshot worker/clone resource cost included in bounded feasibility wall/CPU; no larger runner or resource grant.
